name: JW Marriott Hotel Beijing, Chaoyang District
positioning: JW Marriott Hotel Beijing in China Central Place in Beijing's CBD, steps from Dawanglu metro station, with a garden that has a pickleball court and a yoga lawn
best_for: Travelers who want a CBD base with direct metro access to the Forbidden City
Families heading to Universal Beijing Resort

facts.text: The hotel is in China Central Place in Beijing's CBD, near the Embassy District.
The hotel is a 3-minute walk from Dawanglu Station on Subway Lines 1 and 14.
Rooms are spacious, starting from 42 square meters.
Executive rooms have a contemporary yet oriental setting.
Family suites have spacious bathrooms with TVs above the bathtubs.
iSpa, an independently operated spa in the hotel, offers specialty treatments to revive body and mind.
The hotel has an Executive Lounge and a 24-hour gym.
Asia Bistro has live cooking stations and a theater-like open kitchen.
The Lobby Lounge serves classic cocktails, snacks and afternoon tea.
Line 1 of the metro runs directly to Universal Beijing Resort, a family theme park.
The hotel has twelve event venues, including a 1,230-square-meter ballroom.

highlights.text: The 1,000-square-meter JW Garden has a pickleball court, a yoga lawn and fresh herbs.
The hotel offers direct metro access to the Forbidden City and Universal Beijing Resort.
Rooms have marble bathrooms, rain showers, soaking tubs and signature bedding.
Griffin-themed family rooms come with playful welcome gifts for kids.
SKP Beijing, a premium shopping hub, is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.

considerations.text: Both Beijing airports are 45 to 50 minutes away by car.
Breakfast is available at the Lobby Lounge and Asia Bistro for a fee.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
